subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals needs — FinTechCo
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@fintechco.com>, Brian Lee <brian.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: observability & evals needs — FinTechCo

Hi Sarah / Brian —

Thanks again for the 30-minute intro earlier. Quick recap so we’re aligned and to capture the items we promised to follow up on. If anything below is off, flag it and I’ll update.

Key pain points you shared:
- Lack of per-route token cost visibility across internal vs external traffic (hard to attribute spend to business lines)
- Regression noise when models update — no easy way to tie quality drop to prompt changes or model rollouts
- Tracing gaps: missing correlation IDs across the app → inference traces are hard to stitch to user sessions
- Observability dashboard is fragmented (separate logs, metrics, and manual eval spreadsheets)

Current stack notes (from your input):
- Inference: homegrown LLM endpoints hosted on AWS EC2 + occasional SageMaker jobs
- Metrics: Datadog for infra, Looker for BI, and a few internal eval spreadsheets for prompt-level checks
- Auth & infra: corporate VPC with strict egress controls; SOC 2 in progress (you said you’d share SOC artifacts)

Success criteria you mentioned:
- Per-route token & latency dashboards that tie to product feature owners (visible in <30 min from request)
- Golden-prompt set and an automated regression alert (daily smoke check) with defined rollback/runbook
- Tracing hook that surfaces user-session → inference correlation IDs in traces and errors
- A lightweight canary rollout path for model variants with automatic fallback to a cheaper variant if latency spikes

Agreed next steps (owner / ETA):
1) Redwood — share a short observability demo deck and proposed dashboard templates (attachment: redwood-obs-demo.pptx) — Aisha — by EOD Thu 2/19
2) FinTechCo — share SOC2 summary and a sample golden prompt list (CSV) — Sarah — by EOD Thu 2/19
3) Tech sync (deep-dive on tracing hooks + KV cache expectations) — schedule 60m with SRE + Dev (Redwood) — proposed next week 2/24–2/26 — Dev / FinTechCo SRE — schedule link to follow
4) If trial alignment looks good, propose a short Dedicated-capacity POC for a single route (scope: 1 feature, 2 model variants) — potential kickoff early March

Attachments referenced: redwood-obs-demo.pptx, golden_prompts_v1.csv (example schema)

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with the HubSpot deal link and a shared Drive folder with the demo assets.

Best,

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
<aisha.rahman@redwood.ai> | (415) 555-0123

---
Aisha Rahman
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@fintechco.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brian Lee <brian.lee@fintechco.com>, FinTechCo SRE <sre@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: observability & evals needs — FinTechCo

Thanks Aisha — this is a solid write-up, appreciate the clarity. A few clarifications and added context: 

- SOC2: attaching a one-pager (SOC2_summary.pdf) with our current status and expected control owners. We’ll share the full report under NDA if/when needed.
- Golden prompts: Brian will export a sample CSV by EOD — includes 120 prompts we use for regression checks across payments and onboarding flows.
- Tracing: our SRE (sre@fintechco.com) will need to understand how Redwood expects correlation IDs to be passed (header vs body) — we prefer header-based X-Request-ID pattern.
- POC scope: we like the idea of a single-route POC. Priority route would be the onboarding flow (feature flag: onb-001).

Would prefer a demo next Tue 2/24 at 10:30am PT if that works for your team.

Sarah Connors
Product Lead, ML Platforms | FinTechCo
sarah.connors@fintechco.com | +1 415-555-9876

On Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 3:05 PM Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Sarah / Brian —
>

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@fintechco.com>, Brian Lee <brian.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: observability & evals needs — FinTechCo

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sarah. Tue 2/24 10:30am PT works for our team; I’ll lock it and send an invite.

A few technical notes to prep Dev and your SRE for the call:
- Correlation IDs: we support header-based X-Request-ID as well as our SDK which can auto-inject and surface in traces. We’ll bring implementation patterns and a short code snippet.
- Golden prompts: if you can share a CSV with columns (prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_label, owner) that’ll help us bootstrap the daily smoke checks and create example regression alerts.
- Dashboards: we’ll bring 3 starter dashboards: per-route cost/latency, regression-summary (pass/fail by prompt set), and trace-joins (user session → inference span).
- Rollout guardrails: recommend canary (5% traffic) + automatic fallback on latency > 250ms or error rate > 2% for 1 minute. We’ll propose adjustable thresholds during the demo.

I’ve attached the demo deck and a CSV template (golden_prompts_v1.csv) in the shared Drive link I’ll include in the calendar invite. Also adding Marissa (obs PM) and Dev (technical lead) to the invite so we have owners on the call.

Next up from our side:
- Calendar invite + Drive link (Aisha) — today
- Pre-demo checklist for SRE (what to share before the call) — Marissa will follow up

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,

Aisha

Thanks — adding a short internal checklist before the Tue 2/24 demo: 

Internal prep items (Marissa / Dev owners):
- Prepare 10–12 demo prompts (mix of short/long) and show golden vs new model outputs; include a regression alert example
- Bring tracing snippet for X-Request-ID header and example span attributes we’ll add (model.variant, batch_size, kv_cache_hit)
- Create a per-route cost/latency dashboard in our sandbox with sample metrics (tokens_generated, p50/p95 latency, cost_per_1k_tokens)
- Draft a 1-page POC scope doc (on Drive) that maps success criteria to measurement and rollback steps

I’ll compile slides and a short runbook and drop them into the Drive folder before EOD Mon 2/23.

-Marissa
